required_input_schema.qdistrnd_algorithm_specification: complete source-independent algorithm and stopping contract
required_input_schema.benchmark_matrices: exact clean-room matrices used for every Fig. 8 point
required_input_schema.cpu_runtime_manifest: CPU model, thread count, dependencies, and compiler/runtime versions
required_input_schema.sampling_plan: seeds, repetitions, warm-up, and timing aggregation

forbidden_substitutions: guessed circuits, schedules, layouts, or benchmark metadata
acceptance_boundary: Implement the actual QDistRnd baseline and benchmark it on the same independently generated matrices; full-nullspace RREF is forbidden as a substitute.
